title: Diving into booklet wormholes
summary: ArXiv:2508.17898 proposed the booklet wormhole as the holographic dual of the GHZ state. This paper extends the investigation into this geometry, particularly focusing on the junction conditions for matter fields. We show that the symmetry of the GHZ state requires the bulk to admit special Killing vector fields that standard manifolds cannot realize.
